edits.text: 2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of $350,000 (the “Base Salary”), payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices and subject to applicable withholding. The Executive shall be eligible to participate in employee benefit plans generally available to similarly situated executives, subject to their terms.

3. TERMINATION AND SEVERANCE. If the Company terminates the Executive’s employment without Cause, other than due to death or disability, or the Executive resigns for Good Reason, the Company shall provide (a) severance equal to 12 months’ then-current Base Salary, payable in substantially equal installments over 12 months, and (b) if the Executive timely elects available continuation coverage, payment of the employer portion of premiums for the Executive’s and covered dependents’ group health coverage, at the same level as immediately before termination, until the earlier of 12 months after termination or eligibility for comparable coverage through another employer. Severance is conditioned on the Executive executing a customary release of employment-related claims, excluding claims for vested benefits and rights under this Agreement, that becomes effective and irrevocable within 60 days after termination. Payments shall commence on the first regular payroll date after that period, with a catch-up payment for intervening installments, subject to applicable deferred-compensation law. Accrued salary, reimbursable expenses, and vested benefits shall be paid regardless of whether a release is signed. “Cause” means (i) conviction of, or a plea of guilty or no contest to, a felony involving fraud or dishonesty; (ii) fraud, embezzlement, or willful misconduct in performing duties that causes material harm to the Company; or (iii) a material breach of this Agreement or willful, continued failure to perform lawful duties, other than due to incapacity. Before termination for Cause, the Company shall provide written notice specifying the grounds and a reasonable opportunity to respond; any curable conduct shall be subject to a 30-day cure period. “Good Reason” means, without the Executive’s written consent, a material reduction in Base Salary, a material diminution in authority, duties, or responsibilities, relocation of the principal workplace by more than 50 miles that materially increases the Executive’s commute, or the Company’s material breach of this Agreement. Good Reason requires written notice within 60 days after the Executive becomes aware of the condition, a 30-day opportunity for the Company to cure, and resignation within 30 days after expiration of that cure period if the condition remains uncured.

4. CONFIDENTIALITY AND NON-SOLICITATION. No post-employment non-compete shall apply. The Executive shall not use or disclose the Company’s confidential business information except in performing duties for the Company or as permitted by law. Confidential information excludes information that becomes public without breach, is lawfully obtained from an unrestricted third party, or is independently developed without use of Company confidential information. These obligations continue while the information remains confidential. Nothing prohibits reporting suspected violations to government agencies, cooperating with investigations, making legally protected disclosures, or exercising nonwaivable rights; no prior authorization or notice to the Company is required for such activities. For 12 months after employment ends, to the extent permitted by applicable law, the Executive shall not directly solicit (a) employees with whom the Executive worked materially during the preceding 12 months to leave the Company or (b) customers with whom the Executive had material business contact during that period to move business to a competing provider of products or services for which the Executive had material responsibility. General advertisements, untargeted recruitment, hiring persons who respond without targeted solicitation, and accepting unsolicited customer business are excluded. These restrictions do not prohibit employment with a competitor.

receiver.message_back: We can agree to the $350,000 Base Salary, deletion of the non-compete, and the narrowly tailored Cause, Good Reason, confidentiality, and non-solicitation provisions, provided severance and employer-paid health coverage are extended to 18 months, with salary severance not subject to mitigation or offset. The release must impose no additional restrictive covenants and preserve indemnification rights; otherwise, the proposed payment mechanics and protections are acceptable, subject to our client’s approval of the final agreement.
